apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: oxshibboleth
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: oxshibboleth
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: oxshibboleth
        imagePullPolicy: Always
        image: gluufederation/oxshibboleth:4.0.0
        command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -c
        - '/usr/bin/python /scripts/update-lb-ip.py &

          /app/scripts/entrypoint.sh

          '
        volumeMounts:
        - name: shared-shib
          mountPath: /opt/shared-shibboleth-idp
        - name: cb-pass
          mountPath: /etc/gluu/conf/couchbase_password
          subPath: couchbase_password
        - name: cb-crt
          mountPath: /etc/certs/couchbase.crt
          subPath: couchbase.crt
        - mountPath: /scripts
          name: update-lb-ip
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: 1500Mi
            cpu: 1000m
          limits:
            memory: 2000Mi
            cpu: 1500m
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: oxshibboleth-cm
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /idp
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          periodSeconds: 30
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /idp
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 25
          periodSeconds: 25
